mission.goal: Detect and block false-reality claims, guard Federation-controlled side effects before dispatch and claim release, preserve valid owner capability, prevent duplicate construction, select the smallest governed improvement, and centrally verify and manage Federation and ChatGPT fault books without false host-binding claims.
mission.workflow: Structured claim and evidence enter a deterministic truth gate; a separate capability broker filters and deduplicates a provenance manifest; the pre-build gate blocks duplicate construction; the execution guard gates side-effect dispatch and claim release; and a host-invoked material-cycle upgrade gate checks environment identity, capability preservation and correction debt before routing to observe, patch, candidate or block.
mission.data: Caller-supplied JSON claims, evidence metadata, scope, objective and capability manifests; optional redacted audit log, atomic learning ledger, or verified private hash-chained fault-book registry.
mission.interface: Python library and command-line scan, resolve, prebuild, upgrade, federation-upgrade, learn, faultbook-import, faultbook-verify, faultbook-manifest, execution-preflight, execution-observe, execution-release, taxonomy and health commands.
mission.environment: Offline local workspace; no provider credentials or network runtime.
mission.governance: Formation mission MISSION-REALITYGUARD-040-GOVERNED-AUTO-UPGRADE; A0-A2; zero cost; host-invoked material cycles; one explicitly selected effectful path only after a separate single-use permit; no self-promotion.
mission.failure: Fail closed on invalid input, insufficient proof, partial scope, stale evidence, false ownership, unauthorized effects, unsafe binary transport, unchanged failed retries, idempotency replay, unverified recipients or routes, duplicate capability, capability dilution, unverified inventory, environment inheritance, correction-debt cycles, protected-capability loss, ungoverned self-upgrade and unproven or over-broad gaps.
mission.testing: Fresh source promotion requires the current nested RealityGuard package suite plus root Federation admission courts. Historical test counts are evidence, not a substitute for current execution.
mission.deployment: Not externally deployed or browser-installed. Source-level and local CLI guard behavior do not prove native ChatGPT interception, provider binding or target runtime enforcement.
mission.continuity: Canonical truth, solution, pre-build, execution-guard, upgrade and fault import IDs; idempotent learning and fault fingerprints; deterministic reruns; collision-safe fault-book revisions; dependency-ordered correction debt; project memory, handoff, documentation gate and recovery files.

classification.type: local deterministic truth control, side-effect guard and reuse-first solution broker
classification.data_sensitivity: caller-controlled; secrets redacted in optional logs

assumptions.stack: Python 3.11 or newer with standard library.
assumptions.runtime: Single-process CLI or imported library call.
assumptions.storage: No required storage for scan/resolve/preflight; optional append-only JSONL audit log, atomically published learning ledger, or atomic private fault-book registry.
assumptions.authentication: Not applicable to offline core; adapters must provide separate authenticated evidence.
assumptions.deployment: Local execution only in this authorized build.

components.frontend: CLI JSON interface; no graphical UI.
components.backend: RealityGuard deterministic truth engine, capability registry/broker, solution router, manifest-bound pre-build gate, side-effect ExecutionGuard, governed material-cycle upgrade engine, universal Federation source adapter, learning ledger and central fault-book manager.
components.database: No database; optional JSON registries are local, atomic and caller-selected.
components.queue: Not required; synchronous single request path.
components.worker: Not required; caller process performs analysis.
components.scheduler: Not required; an integrated host invokes the upgrade decision at material BUILD, FAILURE, RECOVERY, DEPLOYMENT or CANARY boundaries. No autonomous or persistent daemon is claimed.
components.cache: Not required; stale proof must not be cached.
components.storage: One selected optional local mutation path per invocation: secret-redacted JSONL audit, atomic idempotent learning ledger, or atomic verified private fault-book registry.
components.authentication: Adapter responsibility; core accepts no credentials.

observability.correlation_ids: Deterministic rg- SHA-256 prefix derived from canonical input.
observability.health_checks: realityguard health emits package version, mode, execution-guard maturity and external-binding truth.
observability.structured_logs: JSON stdout and JSON error objects.
observability.metrics_alerts: Caller may count exit codes, guard decisions, upgrade decisions, recurrence and correction debt; no daemon or alerting service is claimed.

testing.unit: Lifecycle, evidence admissibility, verdict, capability ranking/deduplication, solution action, execution preflight/dispatch observation/claim release, material-cycle routing, environment attestation, capability preservation, correction-debt ordering, learning promotion, event-chain integrity, fault fingerprints and consumer binding tests.
testing.integration: CLI subprocess, execution-guard synthetic failure/repaired fixtures, resolve, prebuild, upgrade, learn, fault-book import/verify/manifest, Federation adapter, atomic registry/ledger and redaction tests.
testing.e2e_or_smoke: Health plus false-ownership, interface-semantic-gap, ChatBridge duplicate-build, genuine residual-gap, material-cycle patch, synthetic unsafe-inline-binary and repaired file-reference fixtures.
testing.failure_first: Stale, failed, self-reported, partial, draft-only, transport-only, receipt-only, unsafe-inline-binary, unchanged-retry, idempotency-replay, unverified-recipient, unverified-route, self-sealing, stale-live-capability, unauthorized-effect, duplicate-capability, unverified inventory, snapshot mismatch, environment inheritance, capability loss, correction cycle, background-daemon claim, authority/cost/burden expansion, lifecycle-gap replacement, over-broad gap, self-promotion, tampered fault events, parent mismatch, duplicate event IDs, false host binding, private-manifest leakage and premature closure paths.

delivery.file_tree: README, package source, versioned taxonomy, tests, synthetic execution-guard examples, provenance manifests, executable Federation auto-upgrade adapter, redacted central fault-book manifest and contract, documentation and competency gates, adaptive learning proof, security, recovery, memory and handoff.
run_commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli resolve --input examples/chatbridge_solution_request.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json
PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli prebuild --input examples/chatbridge_prebuild_request.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json
PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli upgrade --input examples/material_cycle_upgrade.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json

PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli federation-upgrade --input examples/material_cycle_upgrade.json --capabilities examples/federation_capabilities.json --adapter-contract federation/REALITYGUARD_AUTO_UPGRADE_ADAPTER.v1.json
PYTHONPATH=src python -m realityguard.cli faultbook-import --ledger FAULTS.jsonl --metadata IMPORT.json --registry PRIVATE_REGISTRY.json
deploy_commands: Not authorized: create a separately permitted browser/API adapter and prove target installation, binding and readback.
rollback_commands: Remove RealityGuard from the caller pre-output/material-cycle hook; restore the prior source revision; preserve optional evidence ledgers; core has no remote runtime state.
delivery.debugging: Use correlation_id, decision_id, request_fingerprint, learning_fingerprint, inventory_manifest_hash, environment scope, capability losses, correction repair order, structured findings, rejected capability reasons, provenance and optional local logs.

formation.authority_class: A2 local build, private import and test only
formation.effectful_permit: ExecutionGuard decisions are not execution permits. Any downstream side effect requires separately consumed, single-use, action-bound authority and independent semantic readback.

watchman.pre_output_rule: Suppress the original status whenever verdict is not ALLOW_BOUNDED; suppress side-effect state claims unless guard_claim_release authorizes the exact independently verified state.
watchman.promotion_rule: Never promote beyond the maximum admissible current evidence state.
watchman.owner_rule: Only OWNER_ACCEPTED evidence may prove ACCEPTED.

continuity.idempotency: Canonical JSON input produces stable truth, solution, pre-build, execution request, upgrade and fault import identities; learning fingerprints increment recurrence in one record; exact fault-book re-imports perform no write; changed sources retain prior revision identity; semantic duplicates and explicitly superseded capabilities are suppressed.
continuity.resume_conditions: Rerun the current nested RealityGuard package suite and root Federation admission courts; verify the private fault-book registry and redacted manifest where relevant; preserve invocation/source-only maturity unless new target-runtime readback exists.
continuity.stop_switch: Terminate the process; omit explicit local mutation options for zero writes.

proof.test_results: No fixed historical test count is promoted as current proof. Source promotion requires a fresh nested package-suite result plus root Airlock/Bubbles/Leak admission; target-runtime behavior requires separate provider-native readback.
proof.semantic_verification: Synthetic inline-binary fixtures must fail closed; repaired file-reference fixtures may authorize dispatch but do not perform it; transport or provider receipt alone cannot release SENT, FILED, SERVED, CANARY_READY or equivalent states; exact independent semantic readback is required.
proof.deployment_readback: NOT_APPLICABLE: external deployment is not authorized or claimed by this source contract.
proof.scope: Local offline deterministic truth, reuse-first solution, side-effect guard, host-invoked automatic-upgrade and central fault-book management foundation; source/CI proof does not establish universal ChatGPT or live provider binding.
